nodes.title: A compact Euclidean set has a point not strictly between two others
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (L : Set LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space), L.Nonempty → IsCompact L → ∃ z ∈ L, ¬ ∃ x ∈ L, ∃ y ∈ L, x ≠ y ∧ ∃ a ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, z = (1 - a) • x + a • y

nodes.title: Smooth transitivity of frozen knot paths
nodes.lean_statement: let KnotPath : (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → Prop := fun f g => ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space, ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 0 = f t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 1 = g t) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot (fun t : ℝ => A t s); ∀ {f g h : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space}, KnotPath f g → KnotPath g h → KnotPath f h

nodes.title: Transfer of frozen nontriviality along a knot path
nodes.lean_statement: let KnotPath : (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → (ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space) → Prop := fun f g => ∃ A : ℝ → ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space, ContDiff ℝ ⊤ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => A p.1 p.2) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 0 = f t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, A t 1 = g t) ∧ ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsSmoothKnot (fun t : ℝ => A t s); ∀ {f g : ℝ → LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.Space}, KnotPath f g → (¬ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsUnknotted f) → ¬ LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.IsUnknotted g

nodes.title: Positive period and unique fundamental representative
nodes.lean_statement: 0 < LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period ∧ ∀ x : AddCircle LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period, ∃! t : ℝ, t ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period ∧ (t : AddCircle LeanEval.KnotTheory.Quadrisecant.period) = x
